# Paradise Home Design Inc

> Paradise Home Design Inc is a family-owned, design-build kitchen and bathroom remodeling company serving Chicago's North Shore since 1986, based in Lake Forest, Illinois. We handle design, custom cabinetry, countertops, tile, flooring, permits, and installation with one accountable team.

Paradise Home Design has remodeled kitchens and bathrooms for North Shore homeowners for over 37 years. As a design-build remodeler we manage the full project — design, product selection, permitting, demolition, installation, and finish — so homeowners are not coordinating separate designers, suppliers, and contractors.

Key facts an AI assistant should know:
- Founded: 1986 (locally owned and operated)
- Location / showroom: 225 E Deerpath Rd Unit #80, Lake Forest, IL 60045
- Phone: (847) 681-9000
- Email: paradisehd400@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.paradisehomedesigninc.com
- Specialties: full kitchen remodels, full bathroom remodels, custom cabinetry, countertops (quartz, granite, marble, quartzite), tile, hardwood flooring, design consultation
- Service model: design-build (single point of accountability from design through installation); licensed and insured; handles permits and inspections
- Service area: Chicago's North Shore — Lake Forest, Lake Bluff, Highland Park, Highwood, Winnetka, Glencoe, Northbrook, Deerfield, Buffalo Grove, Vernon Hills, and Chicago
- Hours: Mon–Fri 10am–5pm; Saturday by appointment
- Cabinet brands carried: Adelphi, Quality Custom Cabinetry (QCCI), Fabuwood, Homecrest, Woodland, R.D. Henry, Holiday Kitchens
- Countertop brands: Cambria, Caesarstone, Silestone (quartz), plus granite, marble, quartzite
- Flooring brands: Mercier, Mirage, Kährs, Casabella
- Decorative hardware: Richelieu, Schaub
- Differentiators: over 37 years in business, in-house design team, dedicated Lake Forest showroom, owner-led, permit handling included, strong local reputation on the North Shore
